answers.reason: The junior professor is a member of the university, but the senate is a central body chaired by the president for university-wide statutes and strategy.
The budget planning round allocates funds centrally and is handled by the leadership rather than individual faculty members like the junior professor.
Professors participate in appointment committees to select candidates for vacant professorships.
As a member of the faculty, the junior professor takes part in the body where their faculty matters are decided.
The study commission is a faculty body dealing with degree programmes and teaching where faculty members take part.
The examination board handles examination matters within the faculty where the junior professor is a member.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, fitting the research role of the junior professor.
The module revision working group deals with degree programme modules within the faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is part of the faculty's operational matters handled by its members.
Orientation week planning is a faculty matter involving its members to welcome new students.
